jobs.title: DESIGNER - AI VIDEO
jobs.description:
Job Title: Creative Designer (1-Month Reliever – AI Video)

We are looking for a creative and experienced **Creative Designer** to join our team for a **1-month temporary replacement**. The ideal candidate should have strong skills in social media design, video editing, and AI video creation.

**IMPORTANT: PLEASE ATTACH YOUR WORK PORTFOLIO SO WE CAN REVIEW YOUR APPLICATION.**

Requirements:

* Must have experience in social media design and video editing.
* Strong creative design skills and the ability to create engaging content.
* Experience in AI video creation and AI-powered editing tools.
* Experience in the F&B, hospitality, hotel, or restaurant industry is preferred.
* Comfortable working with alcohol-related brands and content.
* Knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, etc.).
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.
* Must be available to join for a 1-month temporary assignment.

Responsibilities:

* Create engaging social media designs, videos, and promotional content.
* Create and edit AI-generated videos for social media and marketing campaigns.
* Design marketing materials for digital campaigns.
* Edit photos and videos for different social media platforms.
* Develop creative concepts that follow brand guidelines.
* Work closely with the marketing team to deliver high-quality creative content.
* Handle multiple projects and complete tasks within deadlines.

**Application Requirements:**

Please send your updated CV and work portfolio, including samples of your social media designs, video editing, and AI video projects.

Work Location: In person
